Chaos Genesis For 1 turn: gain no additional Actions; spell slots and Warlock spell slots are not spent; unlock Flight; ignore opportunity attacks; become immune to Prone and difficult terrain; Movement is not reduced; each melee attack deals an additional 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, and Thunder damage, for 10d6 total. Available Chaos Genesis Uses Chaos gains the identity tags of every official playable race and all seven origin characters, unlocking their abilities by character level. Level 1: Astarion's Bite, Wyll's Blade of Frontiers, and Karlach's starting traits; level 3: Dark Urge Stealth Expertise and Karlach's first upgrade; level 5: Gale's Netherese shadow slot and summon, Karlach's Infernal Fury, and Dark Urge's bleeding dagger; level 7: Wyll's Fire Shield and Karlach's second upgrade; level 9: Dark Urge Slayer form; level 10: Astarion's Vampire Ascendant; level 11: Wyll's cambion summon; level 12: Astarion's bat form. Movement costs are doubled and movement is limited to walking, effectively halving travel distance. The Chaos Lost stack remains after this temporary penalty ends. Chaos Lost: Slowed Spell Save DC Penalty This layer gives −1 Spell Save DC. Multiple layers stack; 3 layers total −3. Lasts until the corresponding Chaos Lost layer is removed. Randomly selects Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder; damage of that type is doubled. The Chaos Lost stack remains after this temporary penalty ends. Chaos Lost: Damage Vulnerability Persists in the current save until spent. Every 10 stacks enables one <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="COS_TT_CHAOS_GENESIS">Chaos Genesis</LSTag>; every stack can fund one Fate Revision. Chaos Lost conversion chances for stacks 1–6 are 15%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 85%, and 100%. Kill reward chance is 5% for kills 1–10, 10% for 11–20, 20% for 21–30, 35% for 31–39, and guaranteed on kill 40, then the counter resets. A success grants 1 stack 60% of the time, 2 stacks 30%, or 3 stacks 10%.
